# djev openness correction (v1.2.11)

Checked 21 September 2026.

## Identity

We treat [`Davipar/djev-dev`](https://github.com/Davipar/djev-dev) as the open runtime for Maisa's djev, not as a separate entrant:

- `djev.dev` and `api.djev.dev/openapi.json` identify Djev as “Djev by Maisa”.
- The repository owner is David Villalón; his GitHub profile lists his company as Maisa AI, and every repository commit is authored by David Villalón.
- The repository calls the project “djev dev”, uses the `djev-0.1` model name and implements the same Noul, Choice and Score decision shapes with native image inputs.

The public repository is the inference/runtime layer. It does not include the hosted service's accounts, billing or operational history, and its local route is not the hosted service's complete wire contract.

## Licence and weights

- Runtime code: Apache-2.0 (`Davipar/djev-dev` `LICENSE`).
- Base checkpoint: [`google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it`](https://huggingface.co/google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it), Apache-2.0.
- djev-specific weights: none. The repository README explicitly says it uses the original checkpoint and “does not introduce new model weights or claim to have trained DiffusionGemma.”

The accurate description is therefore: an open structured-read inference method and runtime on DiffusionGemma, not a separately trained model. `mmastrac/djev-spark` is a related NVFP4 DiffusionGemma structured-read runtime, not a distinct weight-bearing model.

## Scope of this release

Only provenance/openness metadata and explanatory text changed. Every task, prediction, score, latency, cost calculation and rank is byte-for-byte unchanged from v1.2.10.
